A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found the mechanism of compensation of the shrinkage and anti-shrinkage effects in the diffraction cone of exclusive vector meson photoproduction.
the diffraction cone shrinkage due to the Pomeron trajectory can be fully compensated by the anti- shrinkage behavior of the transition gamma -> V in the k_t-factorized approach.
we observe the shrinkage vs. anti- shrinkage competition in the diffraction cone for the exclusive vector mesos production in diffractice DIS.
The main takeaway from our work is that

in the k_t-factorisation framework the cone shrinkage in the exclusive production of vector mesons in DIS is a non-trivial interplay of the Pomeron and the gamma -> V amplitudes, and the cone shrinkage is not necessarily a good measure of the Pomeron slope.
the cone-shrinkage effect is very weak and can be observed in the future experiments only in the case of very high statistics data.
the energy behavior of diffraction slope in the exclusive vector-meson production in DIS is governed by the anti-shrinking of the diffraction cones in the transition gamma -> V.
